featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited Pulse Diagnostic Center, Mira Road with my mother in the morning for blood tests and a sonography. We reached around 10:00 AM and paid a total amount of ₹2,700.

The blood sample were collected on time without any issue. However, the sonography appointment was given only around 12:40 PM, which meant we had to wait for more than 2.5 hours. While the waiting time was quite long, I was not very disappointed, as delays can sometimes happen when examinations are being done thoroughly and properly.

We were asked to collect the reports after 8:00 PM. At the time of collection, the reports were handed over in a standard diagnostic envelope along with the sonography film and a detailed report, which was good and professionally done.

The disappointing part of the experience was the behavior at the reception during report collection. I requested a carry bag since I was traveling on a bike and carrying reports and films without a proper bag would be difficult. The male staff member at the reception responded very rudely, saying that carry bags are only provided for bigger reports and that I would not get one. When I explained my situation, his reply was, “That is not my concern, you won’t get a carry bag.”

After paying ₹2,700 for diagnostic services, such dismissive and rude behavior towards patients is unacceptable. It felt like once the payment was done, the attitude was simply “collect your reports and leave.” A little empathy and basic courtesy go a long way, especially when patients are already stressed about medical concerns.

My humble suggestion to the management:
If carry bags are provided only for specific reports like X-rays or larger files, please clearly mention this with a visible notice at the entrance or reception. More importantly, staff should be trained to communicate politely and respectfully.

Overall, the medical services and reports were satisfactory, but the poor attitude at the reception significantly affected the experience.
